يختبئ (form VIII)
# يَخْتَبِئُ (yaḵtabiʔu) /jax.ta.bi.ʔu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَبَأَ (iḵtabaʔa)
# يَخْتَبِئَ (yaḵtabiʔa) /jax.ta.bi.ʔa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَبَأَ (iḵtabaʔa)
# يَخْتَبِئْ (yaḵtabiʔ) /jax.ta.biʔ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِخْتَبَأَ (iḵtabaʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
